name: プロジェクトの属性概要
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Correct only the start-date icon and extra arrow in image1, the Lighthouse LH09-0011 summary.
ORIGINAL image2 has highest priority for icon geometry, opticalstroke, proportions, alignment, spacing and fine-control anatomy; image1 is only the editable generatedcandidate. Do not infer icons from the rough mock.
Replace malformed calendar/loop glyph with the ORIGINAL small slate start-datecalendar glyph: squarecalendar withtopbar andsmall rightarrow emerging atlower-right, as original. Remove the invented standalone arrow immediately BEFORE「3月30日」. Correct sequence must be: one originalcalendar glyph,「3月30日」, one thin rightarrow,「4月15日」. Exactly ONE separate arrow between the two dates, none beforefirstdate.
Keep everything else unchanged: two-rowlayout, Japanese「属性」「進行中」「最優先」「山田 花子」「礼拝準備」「準備チャンネル」, whiteoutlined山avatar, greenprogress, orangeurgency!, originalblue/team andmulticolorSlackmarks, row2ellipsis, whitecanvas, compactRegularMeiryotypography. No addedendcalendar, controls, wording, card ormetric. Onecomponentonly. This corrects a source-detail error, not appimplementation.
reviewNotes: 限定修正を実見。原画像の開始カレンダー/右向き矢印を復元し、3月30日の前の余分な独立矢印を削除。二つの日付間だけの矢印を確認。二段の全日本語と状態/優先度/担当/チーム/Slack/三点を再確認、内容切れ無し。原マークのバイト一致・書体同一性は未証明。エージェント候補目視確認で所有者承認・新ネイティブ・実装とは別。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
